source.title: Oral anticoagulants, cognition, and clinical outcomes in atrial fibrillation and Alzheimer’s disease: a Swedish nationwide study

extraction_limitations: Supplementary data referenced by the article were not included in the uploaded source and therefore were not atomized.
Individual NOAC agents could not be extracted because the study reports NOACs as a class and states that agent-specific analyses were underpowered.
Atoms are source-grounded extraction outputs and remain marked needs_review because no independent human verification was performed in this run.
